title: Eventual positivity of a finite affine family
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a finite set, let $c\in\mathbb R$, and let $X:\Omega\to\mathbb R$. For all real $t$ sufficiently close to $0$, one has $1+ctX(x)>0$ for every $x\in\Omega$.
